description: Defines an abstract class 'DynamicContentTypeBuilder' for building GraphQL content types dynamically within OrchardCore, including methods for constructing schema parts based on content definitions and options.

classes.name: DynamicContentTypeBuilder
classes.description: An abstract class for building dynamic GraphQL content types based on OrchardCore content definitions, with methods to assemble schema parts and manage dynamic fields.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for building the content type schema.

methods.name: BuildInternal
methods.description: Constructs schema fields for content parts, handling collapse, skipping, and dynamic field addition based on content definitions and options.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the internal cache of dynamic part fields.
